description: Rapunzel's mobility has greatly increased thanks to Red Shoes's parts. She now appears more divine than ever, and grants salvation to her enemies with her new staff that is capable of dismantling even nanomachines with its vibrations.

levels.name: Divine Light
levels.description:
■ Activates when performing a Full Charge attack. Affects all allies.
<color=#00AEFF>Restores HP equal to 2.3% of the skill user's <word_group=10025>final</word_group> max HP.</color>

lines.text: I was just offering my morning prayers... It is good to see you, Believer, hehe.
I feel completely different with all the improvements to my mobility! I'm sure I'll be able to take care of everyone even better now.
My twelve thousand sisters are always with me, here in my heart.
The time has come to turn to the next page. I cannot wait to see what story unfolds together with you.
I'm happy we were able to meet again after so long, Believer. You've grown even more impressive... just like me, hehe.
My staff has a lot of uses, you know. It even has some... special features.
Oh my... Are we trying out a little abandonment play...? You are... such a tease...
I'll wait patiently for you. Take your time and come back safely.
I imagine many sisters now call this their home and hold it dear... It is all thanks to you, Believer.
One day, when the fighting is over, I'd like to spend a normal day here with everyone.
As always, there are so many great places to pray here. It'll make it easy to clear my mind and get centered.
I'm so happy to see you again. Let us walk together in light's embrace.
Your gentle touch makes both my heart and my body flutter...!
You know my body so well...
My strength grows thanks to you, Believer. Did something of yours also grow...? Hehe... Hehehe...
Thank you so much for this. I will use it where I think it is most needed.
Bombarding me with thoughtful gifts...?! If your plan is to conquer me, Believer... it's working...!
You have to give me a chance to repay your kindness someday, okay?
Your kindness always warms my heart. It gets me warmer... and warmer... until...!
Your words and actions... they're always quite the saving grace for me.
Somewhere along the line, my heart became entirely yours. What in the world did you do to me, Believer? Hehe.
Don't worry. I am here for you.
Did you call for me? Hehe.
This way is open.
It's about to begin. Be careful, everyone.
I won't let a single person's blood be spilled.
I'll protect you, no matter where you are.
With this new strength, I hope to embrace everyone...
Shall we catch our breath?
It's important to rest.
Reloading...! I'm spent. Spent...?
I'm prepared.
Into the light... Garden of Arcadia!
Let us become one!
Hehe.
Wonderful.
Oh my.
Ngh.
Ow.
So rough...!
It cannot end like this...!
I knew we would win, because I trusted in you. Hehe.
